name: com.unity.cloud.identity
description: Unity Cloud Identity provides client support for all Identity and Access Management (IAM) service features.

_upm.changelog:
### Added
- `IdToken` property added to the `DeviceToken` class.

### Fixed
- Usage of `PkceAuthenticator.LogoutAsync(true);` for complete signout operation in the browser on Private Cloud.
